newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kali und Salz halts mine output in Canada.
newsitem.headline: Kali und Salz halts mine output in Canada.

text.p: German potash company Kali und Salz on Thursday said water damage at one of its subsidiaries in eastern Canada had forced the group to temporarily halt production at a potash mine.

In a mandatory bourse statement, Kali und Salz said Potash Company of Canada, in which the German group holds a 50 percent stake, was forced to halt its potash fertiliser production at its potash mine in New Brunswick, Canada.
"The reason for this is a stronger water inflow into the potash mine," the German group said in the statement.
It added that experts were currently assessing the situation and what safety measures would need to be taken.
Kali und Salz could not offer any further comment on the amount of the damage or how long the output stop would last.
